title: The glow at noon
logline: The ridge from the seawall at noon, and the glow visible by day for the first time — a warmth over the trees in full sun, the largest it gets. Tourists looking at their phones. One girl looking at the ridge.

panels.composition: The wooded ridge beyond the town from the seawall at noon with a warm glow over it visible in full daylight, tourists on the wall looking at phones, one girl with her back to us looking at the ridge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a wooded ridge beyond a small town seen from a seawall at noon with a warm glow over it visible in full daylight, tourists looking at their phones and one girl seen from behind looking at the ridge, no words
